tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje 'phags lugs la brten pa'i sgo nas bdag mdun bum gsum gyis rang gzhan la tshogs gnyis spel thabs mi bskyod klu dbang nor bu bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī gu h+ya sa ma dzā maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ dpal ldan rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /gsang gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag /'gro ngor 'chi med 'khon sa skya/ /mtshan gsum 'chang ba'i dam par 'dud/ /gang gi ring lugs bsam yas pas/ /'di ni mtha' 'khob 'gro ba'i ngor/ /bdag mdun bum chog la brten nas/ /gshin po rjes 'dzin cho ga bshad/ /tshul 'di rdo rje theg pa spyi'i/ /phyi rol tshogs bsags dang 'brel zhing / /gshin don bum chog nyer 'jug pas/ /spyi byer 'gal ba med snyam sems/ /'on kyang zab mo'i rgyud sde dang / /rgya bod mkhas grub gzhung bzang las/ /'gal ba'i nyes bshad mchis gyur na/ /rgyud don dran dbang dam pa dpyod/ /ces smos te kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'i ring lugs pa a mes mtha' 'khob 'dra ba'i yul gyur sngon dus chos grags bzang po nas bzung da lta'i bar thub bstan spyi bye je rgyas su byung ba'i nang tshan dgon pa nor bu chos 'phel du gsang chen pha rgyud chags can 'dul ba'i nyams len dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs la brten pa'i bdag mdun bum chog gshin don dang bcas pa zhig snyigs dus 'dir gdul bya'i re bskong du dgos gal che ba zhig ste/ ji skad du/ thugs rje mnga' bas ring gzigs nas/ /bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang / /zhes pa ltar rgyu mtshan du byas nas ston par 'gal ba med snyam yang / mdor na chos dang 'gal ba yi/ /chos zhig gang na 'dug na yang / /lung dang rig pas sun dbyung zhing / /nged la'ang de 'dra 'dug na ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad gad byed/ /gnang ba ltar yin pas spyir gzu bor gnas shing lhag par lugs 'di mkhyen pa rnams kyis gzigs shig ces smos nas/

tshig gi sbyor ba spangs nas kyang / /kun gyi go bar bya phyir bshad/ /ces pa lta bu'i rjes su 'brang ste mkhas 'bring mtha' ma'i blo can kun gyis kha yod lag yod kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni gtsug lag khang ngam dben gnas dang pho brang nas bzung tha mal pa'i khyim bar gang yin kyang dkon mchog la srid zhu'i phyir gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su phyags dar byas la bla re yol ba sogs ci 'byor gyis brgyan par sku gsung thugs rten mchod pa can yod na de'i drung dang med kyang 'gal ba med pa gang ltar stegs kyi khar ras gtsang rten khebs sogs gzhi bzang ci 'byor 'bru dang bcas pa'i dbus mañdzi sogs kyi steng gser dngul maṇ+ḍal nas bzung g.yas sgor rdo sgor sogs ci 'byor la tshom bu bkod gdab bya zhing / bse dang shing sgor la mi rung / ci 'byor de'i dbus su dri bzang thig le dbus dang phyogs bzhi gru bzhi mtshams dang de'i phyi ma'i mtshams bzhi de'i phyi phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon de'i phyi phyogs mtshams brgyad shar nub kyi phyi dang bcas par bri thig zlum steng nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru bzang gi tshom bu dbus che chung la dpag pa'i rje chung re bkod pa de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod gru bzhir bshams nang 'byor na sgos mchod mar me/ bdug spos/ zhal zas rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re dang gtso bo la shar du lhag gcig rnams bshams/ logs ji ltar 'os par yi dam chos skyong sogs gang dgos kyi gtor ma dang de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril dang nang mchod/ bum pa gnyis/ bum gdan mgul ching kha rgyan bum sman so lnga chu bcas rdor gzungs dung chos dri chab can/ gos zung / sgrub grogs yod na rdor dril nang mchod rnga sil dung gos zung sogs ci 'byor can no/

/dngos gzhi gnas yo byin rlabs nas mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bar dpal sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i bar khang na bzhugs pa'i sgrub mchod phrin las mkha' khyab par ma ltar la de 'phros 'di bzhin sbyar te/ shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol oṃ āḥru pa sogs tshogs zhing skabs ltar sngags phyag byas la nang mchod oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu sogs gtor ma byin gyi rlabs bzhin la/ spel zhing 'bar bar gyur gyi rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ tshar gcig mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi len tshul dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥha nas hūm̐ bcu'i bar 'og gi nang mchod bzhin la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes 'bul tshul dang rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgyas gsang mchod dang thal mo sbyar la/ gdangs med kyis/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i yul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa khyod/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes pas bstod/ nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gzhal yas khang spyan drangs te rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams pa la bzhag de las hūm̐ yig 'bar ba 'phros pas sa 'og gi bar/ zhes sogs nas bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig gtor ma gnyis bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs byas nas/ 'das gtor dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'bul zhing / mchod pa lnga/ nang mchod/ bstod pa/ bden stobs/ phrin bcol rnams dang / gtor ma gnyis pa phyogs skyong la 'bul tshul dang / rjes chog gi mchod bstod rnams dang / brtan bzhugs dgos na grub mtshams rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas tshom bu dang bum nang gi sogs dpal sa skya'i lha mthil par ma sor bzhag yin no/ /'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rdul tshon gshegs gsol med/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid sogs dge ba bsngo/ dge legs yon tan gter mnga' rtsa brgyud kyi/ /bla ma rnams dang gsang gsum 'dus pa'i lha/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rten dang brten pa yis/ /thugs rje byin brlabs dag bya dag byed sogs/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par sbyor ba'i thabs/ /rgyud dang rgya bod smin grol dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /sogs ci shes kyis 'thus so// ༈ /gal te gshin po rjes 'dzin byed na/ ming byang / byang gdan/ sbyong chas/ til/ chu/ yungs dkar ram bye ma gtsang ma/ me long / khrus dar/ khrus gzhong / 'jim skyong / tshwa par sogs dang 'don dmigs kun dmigs bsal phran bu ma gtogs 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i yig sna'i gras rgya gzhung slob dpon stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes sangs rgyas spyan la brten pa'i 'dus pa'i dus mtha'i cho ga le tshan na sbyong rgyud dang mthun par gsungs pas kun rig lho sgo bzhin la gong gi bdag mdun bum gtor rnams grub pa dang tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal lho phyogs su sbyangs/

stegs dri rten ming byang can sogs kun rig bzhin bshams la/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ shu n+yā ta sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su/ zhes sogs kun rig bzhin la bkug par gyur gyi rjes su hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas bden bdar ni na mo sogs nas dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang bar 'dra/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i sogs nas ḍāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥbar 'dra/ oṃ sarba sogs nas hūm̐ ṭa ṭhā bar/ oṃ sarba bed badz+ra a dhi sogs mi dgos pas gong gi dgug gzhug grub 'phral 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa la sogs kun rig bzhin zhi ba zhi drag phyed ma drag po'i sbyang ba rnams kun rig bzhin la bden bdar tshig dmigs bsal gong bzhin bsgyur/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs hūm̐ bzhi dang / oṃ āḥbigh+nān sogs brjod la bgegs bskrad/ sdig pa sbyong ba kun rig bzhin/ brab sngags la gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor pa'i sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gcig gis bsngags pa'i yungs bye gang rung ming byang la 'thor sngags oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na sogs nas/ sarba tir+ya ga te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa bar kun rig sor bzhag gsang 'dus rgya gzhung na 'dug pas rigs 'gre/ rtog bzo gtan nas min/ bstan 'gyur gyi gras rgya gzhung de la mkhas pa rnams gzigs shig de'i rjes su mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i sngags kyang kun rig lho sgo nas bshad yod cing / gzungs 'di gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i las sgrib rnam 'joms su de bzhin gshegs pa des sngon gyi smon lam gyis grub pa ma zad/ bcom ldan 'di'i mtshan sngags la'ang badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ

zhes rdo rje mi bskyod pa yod pas gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rjer 'brel ba bzhin brab sngags byas pa'i mthus/ khrus kun rig bzhin la durga mi bzla bar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs khrus sngags kyis chog pas phar phyin drug dug gsum/ 'byung bzhi 'khru sbyong khrus rnams tshigs bcad lhug kun rig bzhin/ gang la ser sna'i tshab/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje/ /ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyed la bde legs shog /sogs bdag 'jug chu dbang bkra shis de tshig bsgyur/ rgya gzhung na bkra shis dmigs bsal zhig 'dug pas de bzhin byas kyang yong / phyag 'tshal ni dkon mchog gsum dang nye sras brgyad kyi thugs rje bskul ba spyod 'jug nas gsungs pa bzhin/ kun rig dang 'di sogs la'ang 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams nang gi dkon mchog gsum mam gdan gsum dngos tshang gras yin pas so/ /gdan gsum dkyil 'khor la rnam dag gi tshang ba ni bde kye sogs yin/ rten bskyed skabs bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin dang / stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog byas pa la rin po che'i cod pan prog zhu la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal dang / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ chu gcig sngon 'gro'i mchod pa kun rig bzhin/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bru gsum dang pos nang mchod/ byin rlabs dran pa dang / hūm̐ sa bon/ 'bru gsum rjes mas mtheb srin gyis rten lhar bskyed pa nang mchod 'bul rgyu yin pas bri 'don gnyis kar sgrim dgos/ rig pa dang sogs nas ko3haṃ bar dkyil chog bzhin/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ 'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa can sogs bdag 'jug rdor sems skabs bzhin zas gtad sogs dgos na des mtshon yul 'dod yon lnga bsangs sbyangs/ gong bzhin/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyi sngags dang rdo rje bsdams phyag gis gang 'dod du bsgyur ba kun rig bzhin/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po baiḍur+ya sogs mchod phreng bzhin la rten bskyed lha yi spyan la 'bul bar bgyi sogs/ reg bya'i bar tshig lhug kun rig bzhin/ byang bu sreg tshig stong nyid ye shes ma 'di'i rtsa ba'i khung yang slob dpon stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i dus mtha' na yod par bshad kyang kho bos mthong ba der mi 'dug pas 'gyur khyad la mang nyung yod pa e yin/ bsreg tshul kun rig bzhin la sreg dus sngags oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rig hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes bsgyur/ lam sbyangs bstan rgya gzhung na kun rig sor bzhag 'dug tshe 'das lhar bskyed la ngo mtshar mchod pa dang / skyes mchod dang / drin mchod bstod pa bcas dang / drin lan mchod pa rnams ni gsal bar ma gsungs/ smon lam bzang spyod sogs mdo dang mthun pas yong ba ni rnal 'byor rgyud kun rig byang chog la rung ba bzhin 'dir yang rigs 'gre/ de nas rjes chog gong bzhin zhe dgu them pa dang gson sbyong ni/ rten bskyed rnam shes dgug pa la sbyong rten/ rten lhar bskyed mchod bstod zas gtad rnams ma gtogs gzhan gong bzhin/ dbang bskur ni tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la bshad pa med do/ /gal te phung po sreg sbyong sogs dus mtha' tshang ma byed na sgos chos rnams gsang 'dus gzhung bzhin dang /

spyi chos rnams thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang sogs kyi gsung kyai rdor dus mtha' lta bu la gzhi bltas pas 'thus so/ /zhes dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje 'phags lugs kyi bdag mdun bum chog gshin po rjes 'dzin bcas dgos zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la a mi chos rje sprul sku ngag dbang chos grags nas dngos dang yig 'phros kyis bskul ba bzhin lugs 'di'i rgyud rgya bod gzhung gi bye brag dam pa'i sku drin las thos shing / cho ga'i las la byang chub sems dpa' dpe 'gal med du dpal sa skya'i phun tshogs gling gi rang spyil du bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje 'phags lugs kyis rang gzhan la tshogs gnyis spel thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
